title: The Gold Rush in AI4Math: Where Are We Now?
summary: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have sparked growing interest in its use for mathematical research. While some view this as a major opportunity for discovery, others have raised concerns about its impact on traditional research practices. Despite extensive debate, empirical evidence on how AI is actually being used in mathematics remains limited. To address this gap, we collected all 32,944 arXiv submissions posted between March 1 and August 20, 2026, whose primary or secondary categories included Mathematics.
